headline: Anjanee Kumar Lakhotia files SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure for substantial acquisition in MBL Infrastructure Limited
sum: Anjanee Kumar Lakhotia has filed a disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4) for a substantial acquisition of shares in MBL Infrastructure Limited, as required under the Takeover Regulations; the filing was submitted to NSE on 30 June 2026.
detail: Under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, an acquirer filing a Regulation 31(4) disclosure signals an intent to acquire shares in a listed company beyond the regulatory threshold. The filing is a formal intimation to the stock exchange and the company, and typically precedes or accompanies an open offer announcement if the acquirer has or will cross the 25% shareholding threshold. MBL Infrastructure Limited is an NSE-listed entity, and this disclosure subjects the transaction to SEBI takeover code compliance, including pricing, offer period, and shareholder approval requirements.
